instructions: Treat each module independently: ambiguous shape must not erase a clearly shared function. fan can have uncertain shape while cooling/ventilation is known.

Choose reusable discriminative attributes, not just broad properties. Before returning compare the requested category with its contrast peers using silhouette, parts, surface pattern, and primary purpose.
Do not force every category to have a unique profile. coffee_cup and mug may overlap. Record genuine overlap in notes; never invent a distinction or add the category name as a tag.

Use all clearly applicable taxonomy parents. Fruit and vegetable here mean harvested food, not a whole living plant. A fruit is food but is not tagged plant. eating means an edible item, never a cup or an animal's act of eating; use grazing or hunting for animal behavior.

A module description must explain only that axis. Classification describes kind, shape describes visible geometry/parts, function describes use/behavior. Do not leak shape or purpose into classification descriptions merely to distinguish labels.

Use canonical tag meanings consistently. A hollow drinking vessel has hollow and opening whether cup or mug. Standard drink containers use holding_liquid and serving_drink. Do not arbitrarily vary synonyms across categories.

For a polysemous category preserve ambiguity on the affected axes rather than merging incompatible meanings as known. For diamond do not combine geometric_shape and natural_object. For nail use the catalog Korean name to distinguish metal fastener from fingernail, retaining a note if uncertain.

Typical sketch conventions, not rare variants: baseball has curved stitched seams, basketball has panel division lines; blackberry is an aggregate bumpy fruit, blueberry is a single smooth berry. Describe typical features, not an assertion that any source drawing was inspected.

Church is a worship building, house is a dwelling; clarinet usually a straight woodwind tube, saxophone usually curved with a flared bell; key opens a lock, nail fastens by being driven in. Use the supplied reusable tags when these distinctions apply.

Natural water bodies have recognizable geometry even when they have no human purpose. Ocean is broad open water with waves; pond is bounded inland water. Do not manufacture a function just to avoid not_applicable.

uncertain is reserved for material ambiguity or a genuinely missing vocabulary term. A variation between individuals alone does not invalidate a representative feature. When a useful tag is missing, explain the specific missing concept in a short note.

Return a compact JSON object only. No duplicate tags. Usually 2-8 shape tags, at most 12 per module; all applicable parent tags count toward the maximum. Notes should record actual uncertainty or overlap, not boilerplate such as colors may vary.
note: Project-authored conventions and contrast hints, not human-verified Quick Draw annotations. Unknown peer IDs are omitted.
